Much like thousands of other [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] that were created or converted into battle stations during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], '''Juma 9''' was built to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a base while the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] liberated nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], most notably [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. The station was home to the [[Cryptologist/Legends|cryptologist]] [[Aren Bron]] and the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] and a short [[time]] afterwards, up until the [[Battle of Behpour]]. During their stay, the station was [[Battle of Juma 9|attacked]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces under the command of [[Kul Teska]]. After [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went missing, Masters [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] went in and found [[Switch (clone trooper)|Private Switch]]. [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]] then later found [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and three other [[Clone trooper|troopers]].
